components.text: Use the channel permanent mybigcommerce.com domain, such as store-STOREHASH.mybigcommerce.com for the default channel or store-STOREHASH-CHANNELID.mybigcommerce.com for another channel. Enter only its HTTPS origin. Custom storefront domains need a separate reviewed host policy.

Use an API account with the Storefront API Tokens (store_storefront_api) scope to create a private Storefront API token via POST /v3/storefront/api-token-private. Specify this channel_id, an expiration, and the Unauthenticated scope. Copy the returned private token into the protected field.

Test sends Authorization: Bearer to the selected storefront GraphQL endpoint and checks the returned store hash. Save binds the selected channel host and encrypts the token. The token expires at the time selected when it was created.
